text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v1.14.2 -> prod (regions: eu-west1, us-east1). Canary fraction: 10%.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — error_rate > 5% on embed-encoder-service (eu-west1 canary). PagerDuty incident created: PD-71234. Auto-paging to on-call channel.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired to alice (Oncall SRE). Incident PD-71234 — High 5xx on POST /v1/embeddings

alice: Acked. I'm on it.

ben: @alice pulling logs now. I see timeouts from gpu-node-3, and a bump in retry errors.

clara: Confirming — kv-cache miss spike and OOM-ish messages in canary containers. Tail from the pod: 
```
2026-03-14T02:15:23Z ERROR embed-encoder[pid=1123]: OOM killed process
2026-03-14T02:15:24Z WARN  kvcache: flush failure: write timeout
2026-03-14T02:15:27Z ERROR grpc: stream closed with code=13
```

alice: Looks correlated with canary pods coming up on v1.14.2 ~2m ago. Recommend rollback of canary to stop customer impact.

ben: +1 rollback. Command we should run: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embed-encoder --to-revision=23
```

clara: I'll cordon/drain the problematic node after rollback: `kubectl drain gpu-node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to avoid repeated restarts.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-71234 acknowledged by alice. Escalation timers paused.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for embed-encoder-service (triggered by alice). Orchestration: rolling undo.

kevin: Any confirmed customer impact? CS is getting error reports from an EU customer.

david: Observability: ~12 failed customer embedding requests/minute during spike; mostly eu-west traffic. Notifying CS and support.

clara: Rollback finished. New replica set stable, health checks passing in eu-west1.

alice: Verifying metrics — 5xx rate back to baseline. Good. I'm resolving PD incident.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-71234 resolved by alice.

ben: Short notes for the runbook: probable regression in v1.14.2 memory allocator under long-sequence workloads. Will grab heap/alloc profiles from canary artifacts.

clara: Saved container dumps and logs to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/PD-71234/ for postmortem analysis.

david: Next steps: hold further rollout of v1.14.2, add mem-guard telemetry in canary, extend canary soak to 30m, and add stress scenarios to staging. I'll schedule follow-up.

alice: Handoff to ben for postmortem and timeline collection. Thanks team. :handshake:

ben: Taking postmortem. Will post timeline and root-cause notes to #postmortems by EOD.

deploy-bot: CI audit: tagging rollback commit `a1b2c3f` and recording in release history.

alice: Closing thread. Nice quick rollback — negligible long-term customer impact. :white_check_mark:
